top_signals.title: Asian Stocks, Bonds Gain as Oil Extends Decline: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks and bonds rose tracking a rally on Wall Street as a pullback in oil prices eased inflation concerns. The yen was mostly steady ahead of the Bank of Japan’s interest-rate decision, with traders expecting a hike.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: RBA Must Decide If Rate Sufficient to Cool Prices, Bullock Says
top_signals.summary: Australia’s central bank board needs to decide later this month whether its benchmark interest rate is at a level sufficient to restrain price pressures and return inflation to target, Governor Michele Bullock said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: China's Gree Eyes Europe Winters for Growth
top_signals.summary: Gree Electric Appliances chairwoman Dong Mingzhu told Bloomberg TV's Avril Hong in a exclusive interview that Europe's cold winters represent the company's next growth opportunity, following record summer heat that nearly doubled air-conditioning revenue in the region. She also discussed Gree's European expansion, energy storage business, and AI's impact on its workforce. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
